contract: The registered task validator requires graph_count to equal the JSON-LD graph length and requires the alignment-tier and CIDS-version envelope fields to match the corresponding document fields. It rejects malformed graph shapes without raising an uncaught type error.
limitations: Envelope matching checks internal consistency; it does not independently assert an external CIDS schema version or standards conformance.
The artifact digest is not a signature, and source snapshots, populated output parity, production grants, and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
